origin.origins-classes.warrior.descripti:
These honorable fighters favor the sword and shield to take down their foes.

§6Pairs with the Warrior job.§7 Level it for stacking combat bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.archer.descriptio:
One shot, one kill.

§6Pairs with the Archer job.§7 Level it for stacking ranged bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.rogue.description:
Usually known to be thieves and robbers, rogues are proficient in ambushes and stealth attacks.

§6Pairs with the Rogue job.§7 Level it for stacking stealth bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.beastmaster.descr:
Beastmasters are solitary people who prefer the company of animals.

§6Pairs with the Beastmaster job.§7 Level it for stacking taming bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.blacksmith.descri:
Valued friends of anyone, Blacksmiths are able to create better tools, weapons and armor.

§6Pairs with the Blacksmith job.§7 Level it for stacking forging bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.cleric.descriptio:
They have learned how to channel the magic present in the world and use that to their advantage.

§6Pairs with the Cleric job.§7 Level it for stacking brewing bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.cook.description:
There is no one better to prepare your food than a Cook.

§6Pairs with the Cook job.§7 Level it for stacking cooking bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.farmer.descriptio:
Farmers have been known to provide everyone with food for as long as anyone can remember.

§6Pairs with the Farmer job.§7 Level it for stacking harvest bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.merchant.descript:
Always looking for an additional emerald, Merchants are proficient traders.

§6Pairs with the Merchant job.§7 Level it for stacking trading bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.rancher.descripti:
Making the most of animals, Ranchers are able to gather many useful resources.

§6Pairs with the Rancher job.§7 Level it for stacking livestock bonuses. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.miner.description:
Miners are the most proficient at digging up the earth's treasures.

§6Pairs with the Miner job.§7 Holding both makes the job's vein mining faster and easier on your pickaxe, doubles bonus ore drops and improves pickaxe enchanting. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.lumberjack.descri:
Trees should watch out when Lumberjacks are around.

§6Pairs with the Lumberjack job.§7 Holding both doubles bonus wood drops and improves axe enchanting. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
origin.origins-classes.explorer.descript:
Explorers find their way through the most difficult terrain easily and discover hidden landmarks.

§6Pairs with the Explorer job.§7 Holding both adds Fortune, Looting and Luck, and cheaper villager trades. Powerups you buy in that job also count one rank higher.
